mapper.sql: id, user_id, city, cron_expression, schedule_file_path, enabled, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UserAlarmProfile (user_id, city, cron_expression, schedule_file_path, enabled) VALUES (#{userId}, #{city}, #{cronExpression}, #{scheduleFilePath}, #{enabled}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE city = VALUES(city), cron_expression = VALUES(cron_expression), schedule_file_path = COALESCE(VALUES(schedule_file_path), schedule_file_path), enabled = VALUES(enabled)
